sourceDepth: Fourteen complete returned abstracts were actually read. Initial Conforti extraction lost less-than clauses; its complete corrected abstract was re-read and supersedes the discarded extraction. Raw captures are unchanged.

Five complete RECIST PDF text pages, four dated nonbinding FDA guidance pages, three Therneau vignette pages, twenty-three substantive complete HTML paragraphs plus two website-boilerplate paragraphs are the actual targeted depth.
The NIST short page was read in full as visible text using its declared encoding. Only the ordinary product-limit explanation is used, not the later modified probability-plot formula.
STEEP 2.0 Table 1 was viewed whole at original 710 by 757 pixels, including exclusions and footnotes. Neither the whole paper nor the 2007 table was read.
The STEEP PDF route returned a non-PDF stub despite HTTP 200. The successfully viewed image is separate evidence.
Five Crossref requests returned 429. All fourteen used article identities resolve in Europe PMC; Kaplan 1958 and Fine-Gray 1999 are Crossref identity only.
The Cortazar author PDF was captured but no PDF page was freshly read. Retained clinical trial assertions outside named clauses in selected long summaries are not recertified.
Yao 2023 supports the landmark-time method only. No kidney-cohort outcomes, performance estimates or applicability to cancer are imported.
Therneau September 2026 PDF is byte-identical to the prior capture, but named pages 1 to 3 were freshly re-read. No whole 29-page read.
